canonical_statement: On every probability space, for every ergodic self-transformation T and every integrable real observable f, the Birkhoff averages of f along T converge almost everywhere to the integral of f.
domain_and_universes: Omega : Type u; MeasurableSpace Omega; mu : Measure Omega; T : Omega -> Omega; f : Omega -> Real; Prop in Lean universe 0
conclusion: for mu-almost every x, Tendsto (fun n : Nat => birkhoffAverage Real T f n x) atTop (nhds (integral f mu))

boundary_semantics.transformation: Mathlib Ergodic includes measurable measure preservation and pre-ergodicity.
boundary_semantics.averages: Mathlib birkhoffAverage averages k in Finset.range n and assigns zero at n = 0; this initial value is irrelevant to atTop convergence.
boundary_semantics.normalization: IsProbabilityMeasure mu makes the unnormalized integral equal to the probability-space mean.
boundary_semantics.degenerate_spaces: The universal target includes empty types when they carry the stated instances; no nonemptiness assumption is added.
boundary_semantics.equality_mode: The conclusion is pointwise convergence on a mu-almost-everywhere set.
